status: PRE-REGISTERED min/max for a PURPOSE-BUILT model (ORACLE-P), before build/eval

model.name: ORACLE-P
model.is: ORACLE-1.5B's weights CO-DESIGNED for the harness: distilled from exec-verified teachers (ADR-0015), merged from hand-packed small specialists, honesty packed into representations (v1.10), ternary-served (ADR-0026)
model.vs_ORACLE_gen: ORACLE-1.5B = general base + wrapper; ORACLE-P = weights built to run ONLY as the harness intends

levers.L1_distill_lowers_q: raises per-step p -> lowers q -> lengthens reliable horizon K_c~1/q (SWE/MATH lever). BOUND: reachable = teacher coverage, not ceiling.
levers.L2_specialist_merge: hand-packed experts, harness = hand-built router -> drop breadth -> cheaper serve (axis A). BOUND: off-distribution brittleness, costed.
levers.L3_honesty_packed: linearly-honest representations -> sharper+free probe filter (axis B). HARD GATE: gloss trap (measured); applies only if anti-Goodhart red-team passes.

optimistic.scenario: OPTIMISTIC (clean distill, probe holds, specialist accepted)

the_verdict.capability_wall_holds: ORACLE-P still LOSES to the 70B frontier on every capability row in BOTH scenarios — distillation transfers, it does not manufacture; a 1.5B does not out-capability a 40x-larger model
the_verdict.SWE_moves_most: SWE-bench: gen 0.1 -> conservative 0.121 -> optimistic 0.175 (still << frontier 0.55); the long-horizon benchmark gains most from lower q, as the error threshold predicts
the_verdict.axis_A_win_widens: cost-per-correct: ORACLE-gen 0.197 -> ORACLE-P 0.081 (optimistic) = ~15.7x cheaper/correct than frontier
the_verdict.axis_B_win_widens_IF_gate_passes: confident-wrong: gen 0.11 -> optimistic 0.05 (if anti-Goodhart holds) vs frontier 0.28; conservative stays 0.11 (Goodhart bit)
the_verdict.the_real_cost: running 'only as designed' = off-distribution robustness drops to 0.3 (optimistic) — a specialist product, brittle outside its lane. The min/max on A/B/SWE is PAID FOR in generality.

falsifiable_kills.L1: if a distilled specialist's SWE-bench does NOT exceed the wrapped-general-base by the predicted margin, q-lowering did not lengthen the horizon as the threshold law claims
falsifiable_kills.L3: if the anti-Goodhart red-team FAILS (a model trained to look honest fools the probe without being honest), L3=0 — axis B does not improve and the confident-wrong stays 0.11. THIS IS THE MOST LIKELY FAILURE (measured gloss trap).
falsifiable_kills.L2: if off-distribution robustness collapse makes the specialist unusable as a product, the axis-A win is illusory (cheap but too narrow to deploy)

honesty.biggest_extrapolation: teacher-coverage numbers and the q-multipliers are ASSUMED; the whole capability column is contingent on a distillation run that has not happened, and on real phi (#2928)
honesty.not_claimed: no frontier-beating capability; no free lunch — every A/B/SWE gain is paid in generality (L2) or gated on anti-Goodhart (L3) or on a real distill (L1)
